help.title: Workflow help
help.openTitle: Workflow help: how to connect nodes and what each node does
help.description: Build a pipeline from prompt to finished image: connect the nodes, then hit Render all.
help.connectIntro: Every node has input ports on its left and output ports on its right. Drag from an output dot on the right onto an input dot on another node, then release.
help.legendHint: Data only flows between ports of the same color, so connect like with like.
help.stepDragDesc: Drag from an output port onto an input port; a preview line follows the pointer. A node's own output cannot be connected back to its own input.
help.stepMergeDesc: A generator joins every connected prompt with line breaks and accepts several reference images; a preview keeps a single connection, and reconnecting replaces the old one.
help.stepDeleteDesc: Click an edge (it turns amber), then press Delete / Backspace. The trash icon in a node header removes the node itself.
help.stepRunDesc: “Render all” runs every assistant first, then each generator in turn; results flow downstream along the connections.
help.nodesIntro: Five node types, laid out left to right along the data flow:
help.nodePromptDesc: Write the image description; Polish expands it with the text model. Outputs a text prompt.
help.nodeImageDesc: Upload a local image or import the free-canvas main image. Outputs an image used as a generation reference.
help.nodeAssistantDesc: Expand a prompt, reverse-engineer an image into a prompt, or translate Chinese into English. Its text output plugs into a generator.
help.nodeGeneratorDesc: Combines connected prompts and reference images, generates with an enabled model, ratio and resolution, and saves the result to the gallery; a failed save can be retried in the node.
help.nodePreviewDesc: Sits after a generator to review the result: compare with the input, open it large, download it, or send it to the free canvas for refinement.
help.historyNote: Undo restores nodes and connections only — generated results do not come back, and clearing the workflow discards results still being generated.

imageTools.backgroundNote: The first run downloads about 35 MB (local runtime + model) and caches it. The image is never uploaded; the result is a transparent PNG.
imageTools.upscaleNote: Resampling adds no new detail, but keeps edges much cleaner than a plain resize. Large images may take a few seconds.
imageTools.upscaleLimitDimension: {{width}} × {{height}} px exceeds the {{limit}} px edge limit. Choose 2× or a smaller source.
imageTools.upscaleLimitArea: {{width}} × {{height}} px is too large to process safely in a browser tab (limit {{area}} MP). Choose 2× or a smaller source.
imageTools.upscaleLimitShort: The output is too large. Choose a smaller factor.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Canvas shortcuts are disabled while the focus is inside an input, textarea or select, and while an IME composition is active.
shortcuts.deleteSelection: Delete the selected card / node / connection
shortcuts.pan: Hold Space and drag, or scroll to pan
shortcuts.pasteImage: Paste an image onto the free canvas
shortcuts.historyNote: Undo restores structure and editable fields only; generated results are not restored and must be re-run. History is cleared on reload.

server.sessionExpired: Server session expired, please log in again.
